injection_sha256: je Injektion gefuellt in injections[].injection_sha256 (C4c, 25.08.2026); bis dahin absichtlich leer, siehe injection_sha256_rationale
injection_sha256_rationale: Left empty on purpose. Decision Record M's Anti-Tautologie-Regel requires expected_match_key to be hand-derived from the documented rule, not computed by the rule engine — otherwise expected and measured value would come from the same function and the strict metric for K1/CYCLE would test nothing (b1_bericht_matchkey.md A2). The same principle is extended here to the whole manifest: it is produced and hashed BEFORE the injection commits exist, so the file's git history itself, not an assertion, is the evidence that its derivation is independent of the built injections. The injection SHA (of the 32 commits over baseline B) is filled in during C4c, after the manifest is frozen.
